title: KnowEEG: Explainable Knowledge Driven EEG Classification
abstract: arXiv:2505.00541v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) classification has shown significant promise in applications ranging from neurodegenerative disease detection to brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Whilst deep learning methods have increasingly dominated the research landscape in recent years; these models remain largely opaque 'black boxes' with limited interpretability. In this paper, we revisit the utility of feature-based classification via a systematic pipeline designed to integrate per-electrode signal statistics with cross-brain connectivity metrics. The proposed "KnowEEG" pipeline extracts 783 per-electrode statistical features alongside between-electrode connectivity statistics, utilizing a balanced sampling strategy between high-dimensional per electrode features and connectivity. This feature-based pipeline achieves performance comparable to or exceeding state-of-the-art deep learning models across five diverse classification tasks: emotion det

translated_title: KnowEEG：可解释的知识驱动脑电图分类
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）分类在从神经退行性疾病检测到脑机接口（BCI）等诸多应用中展现出巨大前景。尽管近年来深度学习方法日益主导该研究领域，但这些模型在很大程度上仍是不透明的“黑箱”，可解释性有限。在本文中，我们通过一个系统性流程重新审视了基于特征的分类方法的价值，该流程旨在将单电极信号统计特征与跨大脑连接性度量相结合。所提出的"KnowEEG"流程提取了783个单电极统计特征以及电极间连接性统计特征，并在高维单电极特征与连接性特征之间采用平衡采样策略。该基于特征的流程在五项多样化的分类任务（包括情绪检测等）上取得了与最先进深度学习模型相当甚至更优的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出KnowEEG可解释分类流程，通过结合单电极统计特征与电极间连接性度量并采用平衡采样策略，在五项脑电图分类任务上达到或超越最先进深度学习模型的性能，同时具备良好的可解释性。
en_tdlr: KnowEEG is an explainable feature-based EEG classification pipeline that integrates per-electrode statistics with inter-electrode connectivity metrics using balanced sampling, achieving performance comparable to or exceeding state-of-the-art deep learning models across five diverse tasks.
